scope: Actual embedded curated objects in currently published non-legacy/non-redirect textbook, model atlas and research overview sources, including explicit English counterparts. Targeted provenance review; not a claim that all source papers or all web rights were re-audited.

method.usage: Resolve current manifest source/source_en files; scan wiki image embeds, Markdown image targets and HTML img src for exact normalized/percent-decoded curated paths. Registry used_in is not used as the evidence for actual embedding. External image URLs, unpublished notes and non-curated legacy assets are outside the main inventory.

classification.verified: This pass matched exact primary image bytes and read an explicit named grant for that source object, then added tracked evidence and strict substitution tests.
classification.sourceonly: Retained source-file SHA matches the recorded digest, but a new exact-object reuse grant was not established in this pass.
classification.unclear: Identity or permission scope still requires a targeted check. This is not a conclusion that reproduction is forbidden.

method.unselected: Assets outside the selected provenance queue retain their existing registry labels; those are not silently promoted to newly reviewed rights decisions.

publicationNote: The unresolved entries are a bounded provenance follow-up queue. They do not block this editorial consolidation and are not a general warning against using open educational materials. Keep actual author permissions, named licenses, third-party exceptions and attributed scholarly quotation distinct.

groups.name: Alammar self-attention visualization
groups.finding: Exact primary PNG and page-wide CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 statement confirmed. The former arXiv 1706.03762 identity was wrong; author, primary URL, license and tracked evidence are now corrected. The underlying visualization is presented on the author page as a Tensor2Tensor viewer example; no Tensor2Tensor code license was substituted for the image grant.

groups.name: Voita course originals and reproduced figures
groups.finding: The course landing explicitly invites use of materials, including figures, with its BibTeX citation. This is a useful author permission statement, not an identified blanket CC license. It supports attribution of Voita's own figures; a Bahdanau paper reproduction still has a separate original author. No repository root LICENSE was found at the checked master/LICENSE URL. Existing source-verified records retained; no blanket relicensing.

groups.name: DPO, GRPO and InstructGPT illustrations
groups.finding: DPO fig1 is byte-identical to the versioned paper teaser and paper is CC BY 4.0. reward-model-hf.png is byte-identical to the HF blog/dataset original, with pinned CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 dataset card; it is not a figure from InstructGPT 2203.02155. These two records are updated. DeepSeekMath v3 carries the arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; its current pipeline PNG has a different SHA from our old PNG, so exact derivation needs checking. No general image reuse grant was located on the inspected Chip Huyen article; no negative rights conclusion inferred from that.

groups.name: Mamba and Mixtral
groups.finding: Mixtral SMoE PNG matches the primary paper byte-for-byte and its article has CC BY 4.0; registry corrected. Mamba v2 paper also has CC BY 4.0, but this does not automatically license Maarten Grootendorst's separate illustrations. The inspected visual-guide page exposes no explicit general image license; exact object/source matching for legacy Mamba copies remains a follow-up.

groups.name: GPT-3 figures and model-size table
groups.finding: Primary v4 abstract links the arXiv perpetual non-exclusive distribution license. Existing pinned PDF and extraction provenance establish the paper origin; they do not create a CC or MIT figure license. No paper images were removed and no code-repository license was transferred to the paper.

groups.name: CS231n original notes versus third-party dropout figure
groups.finding: The two CNN note JPEGs are exact copies of the pinned repository's own cnn.jpeg and stride.jpeg; the direct LICENSE is MIT, copyright Andrej Karpathy 2015. Corrected those two entries and replaced their old no-MIT test with a stronger pinned-byte/LICENSE contract. The dropout illustration is Srivastava et al. Figure 1 reproduced in the notes; its separate JMLR attribution and unverified rights state are unchanged.

groups.name: Weng autoencoder/VAE illustrations
groups.finding: The article identifies the autoencoder and graphical-model diagrams and explicitly credits the reparameterization image to Kingma's NIPS 2015 workshop slide 12. FAQ permits translations with advance email and a prominent original link; it is not an identified blanket image redistribution license for this collection or for Kingma's slide. Preserve these distinctions in a future targeted provenance update.

groups.name: CS336 scaling lecture crops and underlying papers
groups.finding: Read the full existing scaling NOTICE, which separates course packaging from underlying paper authors. No root LICENSE was exposed at the pinned lectures/LICENSE URL; assignment MIT is not reused as a lecture/PDF license. MiniCPM v1 explicitly has CC BY 4.0 and supports a targeted next check of the three WSD/joint-fit source figures. Kaplan and original Chinchilla checked abstract endpoints expose arXiv non-exclusive terms. The legacy filename minicpm-cosine-campaign-cost is identified by the NOTICE as Chinchilla, not MiniCPM. No global relabeling of the lecture crops was made.
